meta.title: MediMate – Honest hospital & clinic reviews in Korea
meta.description: Receipt-verified reviews of Korean hospitals and dermatology clinics, written by real travelers.

home.eyebrow: YOUR CARE, YOUR WAY IN KOREA
title: Care that fits you,
even far from home.
subtitle: From neighborhood and specialty to English support.
Read verified reviews and choose with more confidence.
home.placeholder: Which area, and what kind of care?
home.hint: Korean names and areas (강남, 압구정) give the best results.

featured.title: Clinics with the most reviews
featured.subtitle: Ranked by the number of receipt-verified reviews. This is not a medical recommendation.

latest.title: Read what others experienced
latest.subtitle: Personal experiences that help with questions before you visit.
latest.note: Receipt-verified · Personal experience, results may vary

title: Whatever your language,
information stays easy.
language.body: Browse in 한국어, English, 日本語 or 中文. Site language and a clinic's actual interpreters or English-speaking staff are listed separately.

transparency.title: Clear about what each piece of information is
transparency.subtitle: We separate sources and never promise what can't be verified.

items.title: Clinic information
items.body: Names, addresses and phone numbers come from Naver Maps search. Treatments, prices, hours and language support should be confirmed with the clinic.

items.title: Visitor experiences
items.body: Reviews are personal experiences from people who proved their visit with a receipt. They do not verify or guarantee any medical outcome.

items.title: What you should confirm
items.body: Check the final cost, side effects, recovery time and interpreter conditions directly with the clinic before treatment.

items.q: Why do I need to upload a receipt?
items.a: It proves you actually visited, so every review comes from a real patient.

items.q: Can other users see my receipt?
items.a: No. Receipts are stored privately and used only for verification.
Your receipt goes to a manual review queue. You can write your review once it is approved.

areas.title: Where are you looking for care?
areas.subtitle: Find clinics close to where you stay or travel.

treatments.title: Start with what interests you
treatments.subtitle: Treatment names are a search aid, not personal medical advice.

notes.rankBody: Results follow Naver Maps search order. There is no paid placement.

headline: Welcome back.

intro: Prove your visit with a receipt, share your honest experience,
and gather the information you need in your language.
guest: You can browse clinics and reviews without signing in.
Signing in is only needed to write a review.
login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Continue with Google. A new account is created automatically the first time.
login.failed: Sign-in failed. Please try again in a moment.
login.note: We only use your name and profile photo.

hospital.noReviews: No reviews yet. Be the first to share your experience.

detail.reviewsSubtitle: Personal opinions from users who proved their visit with a receipt. They don't verify or guarantee medical outcomes.

detail.ctaNote: Your receipt is stored privately and used only for verification.
detail.sourceBody: Name, address and phone number come from Naver Maps search and may change.

admin.title: Receipt review queue
admin.subtitle: Review receipts that weren't verified automatically and approve or reject them. The rejection reason is shown to the user.

card.reasonPlaceholder: Reason (shown to the user when rejected)

note.title: What to check
note.body: Confirm the clinic name, payment date (within 90 days) and amount match the receipt. Receipt photos are used only for verification.

footer.disclaimer: MediMate helps you browse medical information and does not replace diagnosis or treatment. Confirm actual treatment, prices and booking conditions directly with the clinic.

write.title: Your experience helps answer the next traveler's question.
write.subtitle: Share what you went through, honestly. You can write once your visit is verified with a receipt.
write.hospitalHelp: Please check this is the clinic you want to review.
write.gate: Once your receipt is verified, you can write your experience below.
write.ratingHelp: Use the arrow keys to choose 1–5.
write.bodyHelp: {n} / 2,000 characters · at least 100. Describe the consultation, cost and language support.
write.categoriesHelp: Tick what applies. It helps other travelers choose a clinic.
write.publishBody: Your nickname, rating, visit month, clinic, treatment and review are shown. Your email, exact visit date and receipt photo are never shown. Make sure your review has no one else's personal information.
consents: [Required] I understand what becomes public and agree to publish.
[Required] This is my own experience and I agree to the review guidelines.
write.after: Your review appears on the clinic page. One receipt can back only one review.
guide: Be specific about the consultation and quoted costs
Mention how language support worked, and when
Don't claim results or share others' personal information
Disclose any reward or advertising relationship
write.verifyTitle: Your visit is verified by receipt
write.verifyBody: Only users who verified their visit with a receipt can write reviews. Verification confirms the visit, not treatment results, and guarantees nothing about outcomes.

reviewDetail.subtitle: {author}'s personal story of a visit
reviewDetail.privacyBody: Never share contact details, passport numbers or medical records in a review. This visit was verified with a receipt, but that does not verify or guarantee treatment results.
reviewDetail.separateTitle: Reviews and clinic info are separate
reviewDetail.separateBody: This is a user experience. Check the clinic's address, phone and other details on its own page.
